why_agent_cannot: accept the project's terms in your own name
what_human_must_do: Read and accept the project terms in your own name.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Open the PLAI page Go to the PLAI page on the project's own site, where the token and its claim are presented.
2 Step 2 : Select Claim Now In the Claim Your Tokens section, choose Claim Now and follow what the claim screen asks for.
3 Step 3 : Compare the contract address The same page prints the PLAI contract address as 0x9215e6362F76fc781df00D51293CC7179C6C99A4. Use it to confirm the token you see in your wallet.
4 Step 4 : Look at Aura in Play Hub If you also want to follow the Aura side, open Play Hub , which includes a Farm Aura section. The site does not explain how Aura is scored.
